specification_sets.label: GU80 private swimming pool — water quality parameters
specification_sets.applies_to: Private swimming pools in the Emirate of Dubai. Table 1 is not qualified by pool type, disinfectant or water temperature — unlike GU81 Table 5, this table gives a single set of values for all private pools.
specification_sets.source_section: G. Water Quality Requirements, Table 1: Pool Water Standard Quality Parameters

limits.source_quote: Table 1 'Pool Water Standard Quality Parameters': 'Free Chlorine | 1 to 2 mg/liter'. Column heading is 'Acceptable Range'. The endpoints carry no operator glyph; 'X to Y' under an 'Acceptable Range' heading is read as inclusive of both endpoints. GU80 differs from GU81 here: it states a closed range rather than a 'Min.' floor.

Table 1: 'Bromine | 2 to 4 mg/liter' under the heading 'Acceptable Range'. No operator glyph; read as inclusive. Free chlorine and bromine are alternative disinfectants — only the one in use is judged.

Table 1: 'pH | 7.4 to 7.6' under the heading 'Acceptable Range'. No operator glyph; read as inclusive. NOTE this is NARROWER than the GU81 public-pool range (7.2 - 7.6 / 7.2 - 7.8) — do not carry one across to the other.
Table 1: 'Total Alkalinity | 70 to 100 ppm'. No operator glyph; read as inclusive. NOTE the unit is ppm here and mg/l in GU81, and the range is much narrower than GU81's 60 - 200 mg/l.
Table 1: 'Calcium Hardness | 100 to 500 ppm'. No operator glyph; read as inclusive.
Table 1: 'Saturation Index | -0.5 to 0.5'. No operator glyph; read as inclusive.
Table 1: 'Cyanuric Acid | 20 to 60 mg/liter'. No operator glyph; read as inclusive. NOTE this differs from GU81's 30 - 50 mg/l.

specification_sets.label: GU80 private swimming pool — microbiological parameters
specification_sets.applies_to: Private swimming pool water in the Emirate of Dubai.
specification_sets.source_section: G. Water Quality Requirements, Table 2: Maximum Allowable Microbiological Parameters

limits.source_quote: Table 2 'Maximum Allowable Microbiological Parameters': 'Total Coliforms | 0 mpn/100 ml'. An acceptable range of zero under a 'Maximum Allowable' heading means any detection breaches; qualifier_rule detect_fails so 'Absent' / 'Not Detected' / '<1' passes and any quantified value fails, rather than treating a non-detect as a measured zero.

Table 2: 'Heterotrophic Plate Count | 1000 cfu/ml'. No operator glyph in the cell; inclusivity taken from the table heading 'Maximum Allowable Microbiological Parameters', under which 1000 is itself allowable.
Table 2: 'Ps. Aeroginosa | 0 cfu/100 ml'. The document's spelling 'Ps. Aeroginosa' is retained in parameter_label; parameter_key is normalised to pseudomonas_aeruginosa to match GU81.

obligations.cadence_note: Document states an explicit daily cadence: 'tested daily (before use)'. Encoded as cadence_days 1, tied to use.
obligations.applies_to: Private swimming pool water — pH, chlorine and temperature. Tested before use each day; readings recorded in a logbook.
obligations.source_quote: p19, G. Water Quality Requirements: 'Water quality shall be tested daily (before use) for pH, chlorine and temperature levels.' and 'All readings shall be recorded in a logbook.'

obligations.cadence_note: Document states an explicit cadence: 'for every 15 days'. Encoded as cadence_days 15.
obligations.applies_to: Private swimming pool water — calcium hardness, alkalinity, saturation index and cyanuric acid.
obligations.source_quote: p19, G. Water Quality Requirements: 'Pool water shall also be tested for calcium hardness, alkalinity, saturation index and cyanuric acid for every 15 days.'

obligations.cadence_note: Document states an explicit cadence: 'for every two months'. Encoded as cadence_months 2. No grace period is stated anywhere in GU80.
obligations.applies_to: Private swimming pool water — microbiological parameters (Table 2). This is the laboratory-evidenced obligation.
obligations.source_quote: p19, G. Water Quality Requirements: 'Pool water shall be tested for microbiological parameters for every two months.'
